Rita (marketing): Quick hit  need a compact battlecard update for next week's launch: two measurable econ bullets, a short benchmark callout, and an inbound routing play reps can memorize.
Ben (field): Agree. Econ bullets should be: 1) steady tokens/sec at p95, 2) effective $/rendered-token after KV cache. No vague claims.
Marta (product): Add a single-line ops takedown vs infra vendors: 'Buying GPUs != production-grade serving: rollouts, cache, and tracing still required.'
Kai (research): I can export a mini CSV. Current quick numbers: hosted p95 unbatched ~125ms, batched(16) p95 ~38ms, dedicated ~3100 t/s per GPU (fp16), int8 ~1.6x throughput. Will attach bench_id.
ops-bot: Reminder: include bench_id and owner in public materials. Suggested copy: 'see bench_id=bench-2026-04 for methodology.'
Ben (field): For inbound routing, simple buckets: Trial (<20k tokens) -> SDR; Scale (20k-200k) -> SDR+AE; Enterprise (>200k/compliance) -> AE+SE. One-liners per bucket please.
Rita (marketing): For webinar hook, propose a "serving demo": live routing failover + cost dashboard showing cache hit impact. Who owns demo?
Marta (product): I'll own slides and demo script. Ben, can you draft the routing YAML snippet (1 slide)?
Ben (field): Draft below:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  priority: region
  fallback: cost_tier
  model_variants: [fp16, int8]
  cache: prefix_kv
```
Will add a 1-line non-confidential anecdote.
Kai (research): Sending p50/p95 CSV w/ quantized rows by EOD. Include bench_id in appendix.
Rita (marketing): Copy takedowns (short, provable):
- "Cloud LLM APIs give access; Redwood gives serving ops and deterministic SLOs."
- "DIY often underestimates rollout and observability effort (3-6 FTE-mo)."
Marta (product): Timeline: slides + demo Tue noon, battlecard draft Tue EOD, legal check Wed AM, finalize Wed EOD.
Rita (marketing): Great. I'll schedule a 20-min review Tue 4pm. Keep copy tight and evidence-linked. :rocket:
